scope: Only the cache helper and its existing unit file. Root owns TypingArea collection/invalidation and native acceptance. No browser/build/profile/metric/3D changes in this work.

api.legacy: canCache/store retain whole-word<=64 semantics; callers need not change their existing contract.
api.read: Base eligibility now permits actual cached ASCII space boxes. Oversized current words remain native, as do nonterminal bounds failures, Unicode, RTL, code/free and active composition.

invariants: At most128 contiguous native slots begin exactly at the current canonical cursor.
Each expected value/index is checked against the unchanged target. Every nonspace slot belongs to an entire word<=64.
Finite positive actual supplied anchor boxes and line height are required. Inputs are copied; no glyph advance or trailing/end box is guessed.
Invalid capture rejects atomically and clears old entries. Partial valid contiguous windows are allowed and miss at their first uncaptured index.
Existing geometry/style/font/target checks and single-correct-character transition guard remain; deletion, replacement, errors, composition and explicit invalidation miss.
